The 100 factor is percentage presentation. Diagnostic route entropy, contribution targets, loss normalization and descriptor bounding are not substituted for retrieval performance.

details: Measured scope is one normal-input dataset, MSVR310; one seed42; four additional50 controls. Each has 705 successful formal updates, zero reported AMP skips, and cumulative coverage of all1032 train records. This is 200 new epochs/2820 updates plus12 native updates. Each staged arm has71 outlet-phase updates and634 relation-phase updates; the frozen arm has705 outlet updates.

Each extension starts from the same existing strong shared-DeMo checkpoint selected at teacher E37 after a50-epoch training run, then uses a fresh optimizer for another50 epochs. Comparing against original50 or strong50 is not an equal total-training-budget causal contrast. Ordinary/axis staged parameter counts match, but noexpert is smaller.

The official benchmark selects checkpoints every epoch and has been used for development. These are benchmark-selected descriptive results, not untouched held-out final-test estimates. Seed42 is the only run; variability and generalization across datasets/seeds remain unmeasured.

All staged best checkpoints occur before relation adaptation begins: axis_staged E4, frequency_staged E4, demo_staged E1; axis_frozen is E4. Thus the selected-score table cannot demonstrate successful relation adaptation. Last-epoch staged performance is lower, but that does not establish a unique neural cause or prove every adaptation strategy fails.

Axis_frozen and axis_staged are identical at their selected E4 and in all four selected states. Relative to the inherited private5120 reference, axis mAP changes by +0.004802566pp and Rank-1 by -0.169204738pp (2 rescued/3 harmed); ordinary changes by +0.189779298pp/+0.169204738pp (3 rescued/2 harmed). No comparison meets both +1pp goals.

State00/10/01/11 are dependent inference toggles on one selected checkpoint, not retrained ablations or independent samples. Current AE evidence does not cover missing-input benchmarks, RGBNT201, or multiple seeds. The current handoff correctly preserves these negative results and the unmet goal.
